convention.estimator: GWOSC preferred/default published summary; no recomputation
convention.source_priority: Cumulative official GWTC confident entry; latest version of discovery events absent from cumulative
convention.deduplication: commonName, one selected version per event; O4a GWTC4.0/4.1 never added together
convention.comparison: inclusive >= on published rounded point estimates; uncertainty not propagated
convention.population: Official cumulative confident GWTC CBC + additional O4 discovery events; not an all-BBH sample
convention.excluded: Marginal and third-party catalogs; no alert-only list; no posterior-width or reading-based filter
convention.limitation: Preferred pipeline differs between releases/events. IMR/network SNR is not windowed ringdown SNR.

coverage.o4c_scope: One discovery-event window exposed by runs API, not a complete O4c catalog or live-time measure
coverage.strain_availability: Only advertised links; no bytes fetched or integrity/playability verified
coverage.final_spin: Absent from default API summaries; chi_eff is a different parameter
coverage.preanalysis: Metadata independent of dtau width, but GR PE summaries are not certified inspiral-only fits
